git.title: Git
git.caption: Repositories and credentials Bayplan uses to create stacks from git. Each repository uses the credential you pick, never a guess.

repos.title: Repositories
repos.errorBody: Check the connection and try again.

manage.title: No repositories
manage.body: Add a repository so stacks can be created from git. A public repository needs no credential.

view.title: No repositories apply here
view.body: Ask an administrator to add a repository connection before you create a stack from git.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.errorBody: Check the connection and try again.

manage.title: No git credentials
manage.body: Add a token or a deploy key for a private repository. Public repositories work without one.

view.title: No git credentials apply here
view.body: Public repositories work without one. Ask an administrator if you need a private repository.

usedBy.disabledRepository_one: Used by {{count}} stack. Point it at another repository first.
usedBy.disabledRepository_other: Used by {{count}} stacks. Point them at another repository first.
usedBy.disabledCredential_one: Used by {{count}} repository. Pick another credential for it first.
usedBy.disabledCredential_other: Used by {{count}} repositories. Pick another credential for them first.

errors.nameInvalid: Use 1 to 64 letters, digits, spaces and . _ ( ) -.
errors.nameTaken: A repository named {{name}} already exists in this scope.
errors.credentialNameTaken: A credential named {{name}} already exists in this scope.
errors.unsupported: Use an https:// or ssh:// address, or git@host:path.
errors.userinfo: Remove the username and password from the address and add them as a credential.
errors.caInvalid: That isn't a valid PEM certificate.
errors.caTooLarge: The CA certificate is too large.
errors.credentialScope: That credential can't be used by this repository. Pick one of this scope or an instance credential.
errors.credentialReselect: The address moved to another server. Pick the credential again, or choose none.
errors.secretInvalid: That isn't a token Bayplan can use. Remove any spaces.
errors.keyPassphrase: That key needs a passphrase. Use a key without one.
errors.keyInvalid: That isn't a private key Bayplan can read.
errors.hostKeyInvalid: That isn't a host key Bayplan can read.
errors.permission: You don't have permission to do that.

test.title: Test
test.caption: Runs from the Bayplan server, where the repositories are kept. It lists the branches and tags and checks the sign-in.
test.needAddress: Enter a valid address to test it.
test.summary: Found {{branches}} branches and {{tags}} tags. Default branch: {{name}}.
test.warning: The last test failed. You can still save this repository.
test.stale: The address or credential has changed since this test.

reasons.unreachable: Couldn't reach {{host}}. Check the address, DNS and firewall.
reasons.auth_refused: {{host}} refused the credential. Check the token or the deploy key.
reasons.not_found: {{host}} says the repository doesn't exist or this credential can't read it.
reasons.cert_untrusted: The certificate from {{host}} isn't trusted. Add the CA certificate under Advanced.
reasons.host_key_changed: The host key for {{host}} has changed. Bayplan stopped. If you expected this, an administrator can trust the new key.
reasons.host_key_untrusted: Bayplan hasn't trusted the host key for {{host}}. Test the repository and confirm its key.
reasons.egress_blocked: Bayplan's network policy doesn't allow connections to {{host}}.
reasons.ref_missing: That branch or tag no longer exists in the repository on {{host}}.
reasons.timeout: {{host}} took too long to answer. Try again.
reasons.too_large: The repository on {{host}} is too large for Bayplan to read.
reasons.unknown: Bayplan couldn't test the repository. Try again.

short.not_found: Repository not found or no access

errors.rateLimited: Too many tests. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.permission: You don't have permission to test this repository.
errors.generic: Couldn't run the test. Try again.

add.title: Add a repository
add.description: Stored encrypted where it holds a secret. Stacks refer to a repository by name.

view.description: You can see this repository but not change it.

name.label: Name
name.helper: Shown in the table and in each stack that uses it.

scope.label: Scope
scope.helper: Instance repositories can be used in every environment. Pick an environment to limit it to one.
scope.fixed: A repository's scope can't change. Create a new one instead.

address.label: Repository address
address.helper: https, ssh or the git@host:path form. Don't put a username or password in the address.

credential.label: Credential
credential.helper: Bayplan uses exactly this credential. It never picks one from the address.
credential.sshWithHttps: This credential is an SSH key. Use an HTTPS token with an https:// address, or change the address to the ssh form.
credential.httpsWithSsh: This credential is an HTTPS token. Use an SSH deploy key with an ssh address.
credential.gone: The credential this repository used is no longer listed.

ca.label: Custom CA certificate (PEM)
ca.helper: For a self-hosted https server with its own certificate authority. Used by every fetch of this repository.

advanced.noSkip: Bayplan has no option to skip certificate checks.

loadError.title: Couldn't load the repository.
loadError.body: Check the connection and try again.

gone.title: That repository is gone
gone.body: It was deleted while you were looking at it.

add.title: Add a git credential
add.description: Stored encrypted. The secret can't be shown again after you save.

view.description: You can see this credential but not change it.

type.label: Credential type
type.httpsHelper: Use a personal access token, or a deploy or project token with read access to the repository. Use the token, not your password.
type.sshHelper: Use a deploy key with read access. Add the public key shown after saving to the repository's deploy keys.

name.label: Name
name.helper: Shown in the tables and when you pick a credential.

scope.label: Scope
scope.helper: Instance credentials can be used by repositories in every environment. Pick an environment to limit it to one.
scope.fixed: A credential's scope can't change. Create a new one instead.

username.label: Username
username.helper: Your host decides what it needs here. GitHub accepts any name with a personal access token; GitLab deploy tokens use their own username.

token.label: Token
token.keepLast4: Leave empty to keep the one ending {{last4}}
token.keepStored: Leave empty to keep the saved token

key.label: Private key
key.keepStored: Leave empty to keep the saved key
key.helper: Use a key without a passphrase. Bayplan seals it and never shows it again.
key.retype: Type the new secret now: switching the type needs one.

publicKey.label: Public key
publicKey.helper: Add this to your repository's deploy keys.

loadError.title: Couldn't load the credential.
loadError.body: Check the connection and try again.

gone.title: That credential is gone
gone.body: It was deleted while you were looking at it.

deleteRepo.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
deleteRepo.body: Stacks can't be created from it any more. No stack uses it, so nothing else changes.
deleteRepo.permission: You don't have permission to delete this repository.
deleteRepo.inUse_one: Used by {{count}} stack. Point it at another repository first.
deleteRepo.inUse_other: Used by {{count}} stacks. Point them at another repository first.
deleteRepo.generic: Couldn't delete the repository. Try again.

deleteCred.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
deleteCred.body: Nothing uses it, so no repository changes.
deleteCred.permission: You don't have permission to delete this credential.
deleteCred.inUse_one: Used by {{count}} repository. Pick another credential for it first.
deleteCred.inUse_other: Used by {{count}} repositories. Pick another credential for them first.
deleteCred.generic: Couldn't delete the credential. Try again.
